Fonseca Fitness Brand Spec

Primary Navy: #0F2740
Primary Red: #B3262D
Off-White: #F5F3EE

Recommended wordmark style: bold athletic slab-serif / varsity block
Recommended support font style: clean sans-serif

Usage notes:

fonseca-fitness-primary-full-tagline.png
Use for website hero areas, social banners, proposal material, and general brand presentation when there is enough space for the tagline.

fonseca-fitness-primary-no-tagline.png
Use for shirts, posters, larger profile headers, and places where the tagline becomes too small. This draft is exported larger for mockups and early merchandise review.

fonseca-fitness-horizontal-header.png
Use in website navigation bars, email signatures, and narrow horizontal spaces.

fonseca-fitness-horizontal-header-no-tagline.png
Use in small website headers and tight navigation areas where the tagline becomes too small to read cleanly.

fonseca-fitness-icon-circle.png
Use as a simplified profile icon, app-style icon, or small mark where tiny text would not read well.

fonseca-fitness-badge-circle.png
Use for badge-style placements, stickers, gym banners, and premium brand moments where the Strength / Nutrition / Accountability message should show.

fonseca-fitness-reversed-white.png
Use on dark backgrounds, navy shirts, video overlays, and dark social graphics.

fonseca-fitness-one-color-navy.png
Use for single-color printing, embroidery tests, invoices, and simple merchandise applications.

fonseca-fitness-favicon.png
Use for browser favicon, small app icon tests, and tiny digital placements.

Dark-safe variants:

fonseca-fitness-primary-full-tagline-dark-safe.png
Use on navy, black, or photo backgrounds when the full logo and tagline need to stay readable. This keeps the approved navy/red artwork and adds an off-white safety stroke.

fonseca-fitness-primary-no-tagline-dark-safe.png
Use on dark shirts, dark social graphics, and dark website sections where the main logo should read without the tagline.

fonseca-fitness-horizontal-header-dark-safe.png
Use for dark-mode website navigation and dark email/header placements.

fonseca-fitness-horizontal-header-no-tagline-dark-safe.png
Use for dark-mode website navigation when the tagline would become too small or fuzzy.

fonseca-fitness-badge-circle-dark-safe.png
Use for dark badge placements where the circular mark needs extra contrast.

Production note:
These are cleaned web-ready PNG drafts based on the approved visual direction. Before serious print, embroidery, or merchandise production, recreate the final logo as true vector artwork.
